about: The owner's rulings about words, lines, replies, scenes, narration, the journal, speeches and news text that live outside his grade notes: OWNER-DECISIONS.md, the playtest blocks, prior-rulings and play-first LAW.md. One row per ruling: the id, where it comes from, its date, his words copied exactly from the source file, and the rule it is attached to in line-rules.json (or, in notARule, why it is not a rule). Read by the run's report (npm run words:rules) and checked by src/english/line-rules.test.ts.
